textual.observation: The material invites viewers to register for the ONE network while linking participation with cryptocurrency profit and future success.

evidence.quote: If you want to profit from cryptocurrency and build your future success with OneCoin, today is your chance to fill out our simple registration form, secure your future and join the ONE network.

textual.context: Promotional language directed at prospective participants; no warning, denial or quotation context is supplied.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised profit or future-success outcome is linked directly to completing a registration form and joining the network, requiring later assessment of the offer and conditions.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether registration requires payment, whether profits occur, or whether the stated future success is achieved.

textual.observation: The source claims that a Split Programme can double a token portfolio and increase its value within a stated period, subject to active participation.

evidence.quote: This Split Programme can double your tokens portfolio.
This means if your active, you can increase your portfolio value in just under 10 weeks.

textual.context: Presented as part of promotional program説明; the source includes a condition of being active.
textual.potential_relevance: A specific portfolio-growth claim, including doubling and a timeframe, is tied to participation status and requires later assessment of the mechanism and stated conditions.
textual.limitations: The records do not show how the programme operates, what activity is required, or whether any portfolio increase occurs.

textual.observation: The material links becoming an active Marketing Partner and building a sales team with eligibility for bonuses.

evidence.quote: By becoming an active Marketing Partner of the ONE Network and by popularising ONE Coin you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team.

textual.context: Promotional recruitment language; the source describes recruiting or building a sales team as part of the offer.
textual.potential_relevance: Eligibility for bonuses is explicitly linked to becoming active, promoting the coin and building a sales team, creating a recruitment-related reward relationship for later assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not specify bonus amounts, eligibility rules, compensation timing, or whether recruited contacts make payments.

textual.observation: The source combines a limited-positions claim with an immediate registration prompt and a promised future benefit.

evidence.quote: We are in our first launch phase and have a limited number of positions available during this phase.
Take your chance and register today.
secure your future and join the ONE network.

textual.context: Promotional call to action using scarcity and an immediate registration request.
textual.potential_relevance: A limited-availability claim and 'register today' prompt are connected to the promised outcome of securing the viewer's future, requiring later assessment of the stated limitation and benefit.
textual.limitations: The records do not verify the number of positions, the deadline, or what securing the future entails.

visual.observation: On-screen text states, "YOU CAN INCREASE YOUR PORTFOLIO VALUE IN JUST UNDER 20 WEEKS" and "SPLIT UP TO 2 TIMES"; later frames direct viewers to register and join the presented network.
visual.context: Promotional presentation featuring OneCoin/One Network branding and a suited presenter.
visual.potential_relevance: A time-bound portfolio-value increase claim is visually connected to a registration call-to-action for joining the network.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish whether the claimed increase occurred, what conditions apply, whether registration was completed, or whether any payment or transfer was made.

visual.observation: On-screen text states, "YOU WILL BE ABLE TO QUALIFY FOR EXCITING BONUSES BY BUILDING YOUR OWN SALES TEAM."
visual.context: The statement appears in a promotional One Network presentation.
visual.potential_relevance: The promised bonuses are explicitly linked to the requested recruitment-related action of building a sales team.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show the bonus amount, eligibility rules, payout method, or whether anyone was recruited or compensated.

visual.observation: A registration form with multiple visible fields is shown beside text instructing viewers to "FILL OUT OUR SIMPLE REGISTRATION FORM" and "JOIN THE ONE NETWORK"; another frame displays "TAKE YOUR CHANCE" and "REGISTER".
visual.context: The form and registration instructions are presented as part of the same promotional sequence, with a web address displayed below the form.
visual.potential_relevance: Submitting registration information is linked in the same presentation to joining the network and the promotional statement "SECURE YOUR FUTURE."
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish what information would be submitted, whether the form was completed, whether payment was required, or what outcome followed.

visual_context_notes.observation: The sampled visuals consistently use promotional graphics for OneCoin, One Token, One Network, an education program, and a dashboard-style interface.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin through claims that tokens can double and portfolio value can increase within a stated period. It connects participation and recruitment to bonuses and requests that viewers complete a registration form to join the network, although the evidence does not establish payment requirements, actual payouts, or the outcome of registration.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The promoted bonus opportunity expressly depends on becoming an active marketing partner, popularising OneCoin and building a sales team. This team-based reward relationship is the central directly supported subtype mechanism.
